What is a HUNDY ROLL?

"This is an olde school strategy, not as old as the Matringale Gentleman Tactic, but it’s in iBC lore. I’m long a stock based purely on the theory that human beings are dumb enough to shoot for round numbers. The $100 roll is a trade that is executed at around $97-98 per share...

in the hopes that it’ll immediately shoot to $106. See, once a stock breaks the magical plane of $100, it has no choice but to jimmy its way up to $106.

That’s the way the world works. Do not argue with physics."

In this case, since bitcoin is no longer in the three digit range, the HUNDY ROLL'S name is unchanged but the concept is the same, Humans like round numbers and London is exceptionally volatile, we simply must move with the trend to nearest HUNDY ROLL.

Since we're trading around 9,700 to 9,800, it's only natural we will see a hundy roll above 10,000. This is a foolproof method and works 100% of the time.
